## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.19.3

### 💧 Water Leak Sensors
- Restores the SWS51 Alarm Status and Device Silenced entities using the states reported by that model.
- Removes the unsupported water and temperature alarm entries that appeared as Unknown on SWS51 devices in the previous prerelease.
- Keeps the separate water and temperature alarm and silence states available on SWS0B devices.
- Cleans up stale duplicate or model-inappropriate state entities automatically.

### 🚨 Detector States
- Aligns Alarm Status and Device Silenced availability with the device models that provide those states.
- Preserves valid payload-reported states without creating unsupported entities for other models.

### 🎞️ Recording Playback
- Updates the recordings panel playback engine for current browser compatibility and HLS fixes.

### 📦 Dependencies
- Updates and pins the integration-owned Python dependency for consistent installation.
- Adds dependency tracking for the vendored recordings playback engine so future updates are detected automatically.
